1.1.title: MLA Biography
1.1.reply:
Biography:
Dr. Ramesh Gowda holds an MBBS from Bangalore Medical College and a Master's in Public Policy from Harvard University. He worked as a public health policy director for 15 years before entering public service.

1.2.title: Development Work
1.2.reply:
Notable Ward Projects (2020-2026):
- 50+ Namma Clinics established (Free healthcare)
- 120km of roads resurfaced and pothole-free
- 4 public parks renovated with walking tracks
- 3 government schools upgraded with digital labs.

1.3.title: Campaign Office
1.3.reply:
Campaign Office Address:
No. 42, 8th Cross Road, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru - 560003.
Google Maps Link: https://maps.google.com/mla-office
Open hours: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM daily.

2.1.reply: Please reply with your 10-digit BESCOM Account ID (e.g. 1029384756) to log the power outage directly on our system.

2.2.title: Billing & Meter Issues
2.2.reply:
For billing disputes or meter defects under BESCOM:
- Call billing helpline: 080-22441912
- File a billing dispute ticket: https://bescom.co.in/billing
- Our ward desk can escalate billing errors. Reply with your complaint details.

2.3.reply: Transferring your chat to the Ward 4 Campaign Representative. Please hold...

3.1.title: Report Water Leakage
3.1.reply: To report a water leakage, please reply with the street name and nearest landmark. You can also upload a photo on our portal: https://bwssb.karnataka.gov.in/leak

3.2.title: Subsidized Water Tanker
3.2.reply:
Water tanker booking portal:
Dr. Ramesh Gowda's desk provides subsidized BWSSB water tankers to water-scarce blocks. Please enter your BWSSB connection ID or reply with your street address to book.

3.3.title: Sewage Blockage
3.3.reply:
For sewage overflow or blocked drains:
- Call BWSSB helpline: 1916
- A cleaning crew is active in Ward 4. Reply with the street name to dispatch the jetting machine.

5.1.title: Report a Pothole
5.1.reply: Please describe the pothole location in our ward. We log pothole complaints directly with the BBMP ward engineers. We aim to repair within 48 hours.

5.2.title: Streetlight Failure
5.2.reply: To report a streetlight failure, please reply with the nearest building address or the pole ID. Repair SLA is 48 hours.

5.3.title: Garbage Clearance
5.3.reply: For missed garbage pickup or illegal dumping: Reply with the block details. The ward auto-tipper supervisor will be notified.
